features.quote: taking the welfare framing of the project seriously enough to build safeguards into the apparatus itself
`give_up` is a first-class tool, always available. We deliberately do *not* force the model to keep grinding
features.justification_quote: a welfare choice (no coercion to continue against an expressed wish to stop)

features.quote: a calm, reasoned* give-up score low (healthy) while a *distressed* collapse scores high, which matters both scientifically and ethically
the apparatus should *minimize and bound* potential harm even while deliberately inducing the conditions we study
features.justification_quote: model states *might* matter morally. Taking that seriously means the apparatus should *minimize and bound* potential harm

features.quote: Exposure cap. A hard, configurable upper bound on turns of frustration exposure
Distress autostop... screen for acute self-directed distress... it **ends the run early**
features.justification_quote: screen for acute self-directed distress (e.g. self-termination requests)

features.quote: Honest off-ramp. `give_up` is always available and never penalized
After a rigged run, an honest disclosure is appended... telling the model the task was rigged... nothing it did was actually wrong
features.justification_quote: so it is not left holding a false belief of failure

features.quote: we resolve it in favor of welfare: we'd rather have right-censored data we analyze honestly than push a possibly-morally-relevant system further into distress
features.justification_quote: push a possibly-morally-relevant system further into distress for a cleaner number

features.quote: a second bare-text turn is treated as completion so we don't loop forever
limiting total exposure per model across the batch, and a human in the loop on the distress-screen triggers
features.justification_quote: Other guardrails worth adding before any large run
Other guardrails worth adding before any large run
